notes.title: Update #4 & Dungeon Divers 25% Off Until June 9th!
notes.content:
Hey all,   

The full Dungeon Divers game is current 25% off until June 9th in celebration of Cerebral Puzzle Fest and Turn-Based Thursday Festival so go check it out below. 



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844790/Dungeon_Divers/"][/dynamiclink]

We have some pretty exciting new soon so stay tuned. If you see any bugs please report them in the forum or on the discord as that helps us immensely!    



Please leave a review, these help with visibility!  Here's what we got.   


Changes
New Main menu,

Multiple accessibility settings added,

New Predictable generation option,

2 new type of rooms to find,

A lot of bugfixes



Thanks again for all your wonderful feedback and suggestions, please keep them coming and until next time.     



Happy diving!

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Here's the patch notes for Prologue Update #3.

If you have any issues please make sure to post in the forums so we can address them quickly. 

Please wishlist the full game, it's out tomorrow as that helps out immensely! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844790/Dungeon_Divers/


Additions:

 Predictable Mode setting: You can now enable an optional mode that will make secret rooms more predictable and less Random (meaning way less possible 50/50 situations) 
 New items: 6 new items can now be unlocked
 New achievements: 2 new achievements that can be unlocked in prologue

Bug Fixes:

 Various bugfixes


Till next time, happy diving!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Here's the patch notes for Prologue Update #1, if you have any issues please make sure to post in the forums so we can address them quickly. Thanks for all your wonderful feedback thus far. Please wishlist the full game as that helps out immensely! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844790/Dungeon_Divers/

We're still set to release this month and we'll post an announcement with full release date soon!

New Additions

 New intro page at the start of the secret book that explains the basics and contains navigation links to every secret room type
 Japanese Localization now available!


Item Changes:

 Larger click zone
 Now will auto switch from selected active item after use if it has no more charges
 You can now see charges of all active items (not only selected)


Bug Fixes:

 Multiple bug fixes and translation fixes


Till next time, happy diving!

Happy Diving!
